info.title: Baseout API
info.description: Public read-only REST API for Baseout.

get.summary: Get an Organization's profile.
List the Organization's Spaces.
Get a Space's detail.
List a Space's connected Platforms with connection status.
List backup runs (newest first) with status/kind/date/base filters.
Get a backup run with per-base and per-table breakdown.
Get the Space's backup configuration.
Get the Space's retention policy.
Backup status rollup: last run, next scheduled, 30-day success rate, consecutive failures.
List the Space's bases.
Get a base's detail.
List a base's tables.
Get a table (flat by id); ?expand=fields embeds its fields.
List a table's fields.
Get a field (flat by id).
Schema changelog (filterable, newest first).
Captured schema versions for a base.
Convenience schema search (GET ?q=) — POST with defaults.

post.summary: Structured schema search (heterogeneous hits with ancestry).

get.summary: List the Space's documents (newest first, with tag counts).

post.summary: Create a document (markdown or Plate body).

get.summary: Get a document (body, tags with removed-entity flags, links, diagrams).

patch.summary: Update a document (title, markdown or Plate body, tags, links).

delete.summary: Delete a document and its tags, links, and diagrams.

get.summary: Documents tagging a schema entity (base, table, field, or view).

post.summary: Tag a document with a schema entity (idempotent).

delete.summary: Remove a document's tag by its target entity.

get.summary: List the Space's saved views (Data Browse presets).

post.summary: Create a saved view. The table choice is locked at creation.

get.summary: Get a saved view (name, table, full config).

patch.summary: Update a saved view's name, config, pinned, or sort order (never its table).

get.summary: Search record values and field names across the Space's backed-up data (grouped base → table; `partial` flags a hit scan budget).
Search documents by title or excerpt.
Search the Space's report definitions by name.
Search captured attachments by filename, with class/base/table/size/date filters.
The Organization's plan, monthly API-call allowance, and month-to-date usage.
